title: The Vars Table in wrangler.toml
description: The vars table that holds non-secret configuration in the config file, committed to the repository on purpose.

steps.description: This is the `[vars]` table in `wrangler.toml`. It holds configuration that is not secret, and it is committed to your repository.
`MODEL_NAME` and `ENVIRONMENT` are plain values. Both comments note they are safe to commit because they are not secrets.
The comment reminds you to keep only non-sensitive values in this file.
